channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Giannis Antetokounmpo | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Giannis Antetokounmpo from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Bam Adebayo on Giannis Antetokounmpo
item.description:
Miami will need to add layers to what they do on offense as the season progresses, but the first two games suggest Miami could have what it takes to be an even stronger offensive unit this season.

“I mean, last year, we led the league in 140-point games and that’s with no Giannis Antetokounmpo,”

Bam Adebayo on Giannis Antetokounmpo, Oct 9, 2026. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Giannis Antetokounmpo
item.description:

item.title: Nikola Jovic on Giannis Antetokounmpo
item.description:
Nikola Jovic on Giannis passing ability:

“He can pass the sh*t out of the ball. It’s insane. Sometimes he’ll pass it in the right spot but you’re not there and it’s like ‘ahh f*ck, I gotta get to the right spot.’ You have this superstar that two guys have to guard Everytime and he still finds you right away in the perfect spot. We played pickup yesterday and Pelle had 6 wide open dunks. It’s insane how good his court vision is.”

Nikola Jovic on Giannis Antetokounmpo, Oct 1, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Dwyane Wade on Giannis Antetokounmpo
item.description:
Erik Spoelstra says players want to play with Bam Adebayo just like they wanted to play with Dwyane Wade:

“Bam was a huge selling point. (For Giannis) — He has so much respect in the league similarly to when Dwyane was here, guys want to play with him because they think it leads to winning. They think he’s the right teammate and about the right things”

Dwyane Wade on Giannis Antetokounmpo, Sep 29, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Giannis Antetokounmpo
item.description:
Erik Spoelstra on Giannis:

“We brought him here for a reason. He's here for a reason. We want him to establish himself in that conversation of best player in the league.”

Erik Spoelstra on Giannis Antetokounmpo, Sep 28, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Vin Baker on Giannis Antetokounmpo
item.description:
Vin Baker has also been around Giannis Antetokounmpo long enough to know that Antetokounmpo is motivated entering his first season with the Heat.

“Giannis is one of the greatest athletes we have today in sports, and he’s motivated,”

Vin Baker on Giannis Antetokounmpo, Sep 24, 2026. Source: Miami Herald.

item.title: Davion Mitchell on Giannis Antetokounmpo
item.description:
“But now they have [to deal with] Giannis too? Where are they going to put him? I can pick somebody out of bounds, and if they blow by me, I know someone will have my back.“They want to win Defensive Player of the Year too just as much as we do. We have this competitive spirit, where, ‘I’m trying to win Defensive Player of the Year’ and ‘I’m trying to win Defensive Player of the Year.’“We have three, really four [great defenders], with Wiggs. There are some matchups he guards the best player. Sometimes I do. I’ve got shifty, quicker guys. He’s got guys who are much taller, get to their spots. The defense is going to be amazing. I can’t wait.”

Davion Mitchell on Giannis Antetokounmpo, Sep 18, 2026. Source: Miami Herald.

item.title: Joel Embiid on Giannis Antetokounmpo
item.description:
Channing Frye says Giannis is a 7’0 running back and isn’t as skilled as Joel Embiid:

“Giannis is a 7’0 running back. He’s just coming at you. If his ankle, knee, hip, shoulder, are injured, he can’t play his style. He does not have the skillset. Meaning shooting, middys, post ups, 3s, to balance that out like Joel Embiid does. Joel when he’s injured, he can just shoot fadeaway and still get 30 PPG. Giannis doesn’t have that skillset because of his physicality.”

Joel Embiid on Giannis Antetokounmpo, Sep 11, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jason Kidd on Giannis Antetokounmpo, Jalen Brunson
item.description:
“And so I would never say no to coaching. Maybe somewhere down the future, but also right now I’m just at home really trying to enjoy my family. And then also just watching the game and seeing if I can help others still from the coaching side. I’m always talking to Jalen Brunson and to Giannis. So just trying to help others now that I’m not coaching.”

Jason Kidd on Giannis Antetokounmpo, Jalen Brunson, Aug 29, 2026. Source: Dallas Sports Journal.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Giannis Antetokounmpo
item.description:
Coach Spo on the narrative the Heat don’t have shooting:

“We love it. I think there’s going to be a lot of eyeballs on our team this year. This is what we wanted. — it was certainly something we wanted to address with the addition of Giannis and we think we’ve addressed that”

Erik Spoelstra on Giannis Antetokounmpo, Aug 25, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Bobby Portis on Giannis Antetokounmpo
item.description:
Bobby Portis on getting traded with Giannis to the Miami Heat:

“It’s fun being able to still play with Giannis. We have a great relationship on and off the court. It’s kind of cool going to a new situation with somebody that you’re super familiar with. I think that’ll make my transition real smooth. — I rock with Gianni. Gianni a good dude. He always showed love to me since day 1. — I remember after we won the chip the first thing he told our GM and owner ‘We gotta sign Bobby back! We gotta sign Bobby back!’”

Bobby Portis on Giannis Antetokounmpo, Jul 28, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Bobby Portis on Ray Allen, Chris Bosh, Giannis Antetokounmpo
item.description:
Bobby Portis on being a Heat fan his whole life, and conversations he had with Giannis about coming to Miami:

“I’ve been a Heatle. I’ve been rocking with the Heat since the Mavericks and the Spurs in the finals. Ray Allen in the corner, Chris Bosh offensive rebound, pass out to the corner, bow! Everybody thought it was over with the ropes out. The conversations I had with Giannis has just always been about winning. Where can we go to win? How can we get another championship? Once you guys talk to him at 3 you’ll understand all he cares about is winning.”

Bobby Portis on Ray Allen, Chris Bosh, Giannis Antetokounmpo, Jul 16, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Giannis Antetokounmpo
item.description:
Oh No He Didn't: Spo on Giannis:

“On any given day, he's already done it twice in his career where he's been the best on the planet...and that's what we're looking forward to moving forward. No pressure on that”

Erik Spoelstra on Giannis Antetokounmpo, Jul 16, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Pat Riley on Giannis Antetokounmpo
item.description:

item.title: Pat Riley on Giannis Antetokounmpo, Bobby Portis
item.description:
Your Miami HEAT announced today that they have acquired NBA Champion, Two-Time NBA MVP and 10-time NBA All-Star Giannis Antetokounmpo and NBA Champion Bobby Portis Jr. from the Milwaukee Bucks in exchange for Tyler Herro, Kasparas Jakučionis, Jaime Jaquez Jr., Kel’el Ware, three first round picks…

“The announcement of today’s trade for Giannis Antetokounmpo and Bobby Portis Jr. is one of the great trades in HEAT history,”

Pat Riley on Giannis Antetokounmpo, Bobby Portis, Jul 6, 2026. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: AJ Dybantsa on Jrue Holiday, Giannis Antetokounmpo
item.description:
“So he would compare, for example, my lateral movement compared to Jrue Holiday or my vertical jump compared to Giannis [Antetokounmpo]. So I kind of got to see where I was ranked early on in my college career.”

AJ Dybantsa on Jrue Holiday, Giannis Antetokounmpo, Apr 29, 2026. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Charlie Villanueva on Giannis Antetokounmpo, Paolo Banchero
item.description:
During the To the Baha podcast, Villanueva stated that Giannis will be a part of the Orlando Magic next season, while in return the Bucks will receive Orlando’s All-Star forward.

“You know I'm involved in the Milwaukee Bucks situation, I'm involved with organization somehow, someway. You know where he's going? Orlando Magic. Remember I said that. Giannis is going to the Orlando Magic. Paolo (Banchero), have a good night,”

Charlie Villanueva on Giannis Antetokounmpo, Paolo Banchero, Apr 17, 2026. Source: BasketNews.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Giannis Antetokounmpo
item.description:
Doc Rivers:

“I made a joke before All-Star where I said, 'Giannis should trade Shams.' Shams took that so personal that he actually called the Bucks and yelled at them to take it down. The NBA called the Bucks and are like, 'Shams wants us to tell you this, but we really don't care.' And then the NBA posted it! I've heard from 10 different people that Shams is going to do revenge article on you guys and on you. And I was like, 'okay, I don't care.'”

Doc Rivers on Giannis Antetokounmpo, Apr 10, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Giannis Antetokounmpo
item.description:
Doc Rivers:

“It's really cool. Giannis told me his hands were sweaty, so I thought that was hilarious... He grabbed my hands and said,'My hands are sweating. I'm so nervous right now for my brother.'”

Doc Rivers on Giannis Antetokounmpo, Mar 31, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Giannis Antetokounmpo
item.description:
Doc Rivers, on Giannis Antetokounmpo:

“The good news was it was a really good image, so there was no damage. Nothing. It was really just good news. But I don't know the next part (re: a timeline).”

Doc Rivers on Giannis Antetokounmpo, Mar 17, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Bobby Portis on Giannis Antetokounmpo
item.description:
Bobby Portis:

“Last time I got on here, I said it was relieving that he’s talking in a way that shows he doesn’t want to leave, and that we can get a breath of fresh air in general. I think there was so much pressure on our team this year,with so much outside media about Giannis leaving the Bucks—him requesting a trade—or people pushing that narrative, and it gets to the guys on the team. Guys feel that pressure, especially playing with the Bucks, playing with an all-time great. There are always narratives about winning—whether the guys around him are the right guys, and whether the organization is still the organization for him. So much goes into it.”

Bobby Portis on Giannis Antetokounmpo, Feb 24, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Stephen Curry on Giannis Antetokounmpo
item.description:

item.title: Doc Rivers on Giannis Antetokounmpo
item.description:
Oh No He Didn't: Doc Rivers:

“Giannis is gonna play. I think Giannis is going to come back and play at some point. We just don't know when that point is. He's progressing. I've been here through two playoff series so far and I've yet to have a healthy team. Giannis wants to be healthy”

Doc Rivers on Giannis Antetokounmpo, Feb 1, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Giannis Antetokounmpo
item.description:
Oh No He Didn't: Doc Rivers on Giannis:

“He wants to be a buck, he loves the city and that's all I can go by as a coach right now. Has it been difficult? Yeah. My favorite day of the year this year will be the day after the trade deadline. I think everyone will be here”

Doc Rivers on Giannis Antetokounmpo, Feb 1, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Draymond Green on Giannis Antetokounmpo
item.description:
While Green stressed he has no direct knowledge of the Warriors’ plans, he acknowledged the ripple effect Antetokounmpo’s uncertain future has created across the league.

“I did see that Giannis is preparing for an exit from Milwaukee, whether that’s at the deadline or the offseason,”

Draymond Green on Giannis Antetokounmpo, Jan 30, 2026. Source: NBC Sports Bay Area.
